title: Needn't have, didn't need to, be supposed to
summary: Phân biệt needn't have done (làm rồi mới biết không cần) và didn't need to (không cần nên không làm); be supposed to = lẽ ra phải.

dialogue.vi: Mình mang bánh mì cho mọi người này.

dialogue.en: Oh, you [[needn't have brought]] food. Lunch is free today.
dialogue.vi: Ồ, bạn không cần mang đâu. Hôm nay bữa trưa miễn phí.
Thật à? Có ai nói mình đâu.

dialogue.en: Lan [[was supposed to]] send an email about it.
dialogue.vi: Lan lẽ ra phải gửi email báo rồi.

dialogue.en: Well, I [[didn't need to]] buy drinks, at least.
dialogue.vi: Thôi, ít ra mình đã không phải mua nước.

dialogue.en: Good. And we [['re supposed to]] start at one.
dialogue.vi: Tốt. Mà mình phải bắt đầu lúc một giờ đấy.

sections.heading: Needn't have + V3: làm rồi, hóa ra thừa
sections.rule: **needn't have + V3** = **đã làm**, nhưng hóa ra **không cần**.

examples.en: You [[needn't have cooked]]. We already ate.
examples.vi: Bạn không cần nấu đâu. Chúng tôi ăn rồi.

examples.en: I [[needn't have worried]]. The test was easy.
examples.vi: Lẽ ra tôi không cần lo. Bài kiểm tra dễ.
examples.why: Đã lo, hóa ra không cần.

check.prompt: I ___ an umbrella. It didn't rain at all.
check.explain: Đã mang, hóa ra thừa → needn't have taken.

sections.heading: Didn't need to + V: không cần (nên thường không làm)
sections.rule: **didn't need to + V** = **không cần** làm (thường hiểu là đã **không làm**).

examples.en: We [[didn't need to]] book. The restaurant was empty.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi không cần đặt bàn. Nhà hàng vắng.

examples.en: She [[didn't need to]] take a taxi; her friend drove her.
examples.vi: Cô ấy không cần đi taxi; bạn chở cô ấy.

check.prompt: I ___ get up early, so I slept until nine.
check.explain: Không cần nên không làm → didn't need to.

sections.heading: Be supposed to: quy định, kỳ vọng
sections.rule: **be supposed to + V** = **phải, được cho là phải** (theo quy định, kế hoạch). Quá khứ **was supposed to** = lẽ ra phải (nhưng không làm).

examples.en: You [['re supposed to]] wear a helmet.
examples.vi: Bạn phải đội mũ bảo hiểm.

examples.en: The train [[was supposed to]] arrive at six.
examples.vi: Tàu lẽ ra đến lúc sáu giờ.
Bạn không được đỗ xe ở đây.

check.prompt: He ___ call me yesterday, but he forgot.
check.explain: Lẽ ra phải (quá khứ) → was supposed to.

mistakes.wrong: I needn't have went to the bank.
mistakes.right: I needn't have gone to the bank.

mistakes.wrong: You didn't need to buying milk.
mistakes.right: You didn't need to buy milk.
We are supposed to finish today.

mistakes.wrong: I didn't need to bring a coat, but I brought one and it was hot.
mistakes.right: I needn't have brought a coat; it was hot.
mistakes.why: Đã mang mà thừa → needn't have brought.

mistakes.wrong: She is supposed to arrived yesterday.
mistakes.right: She was supposed to arrive yesterday.
mistakes.why: Quá khứ → was supposed to + V.

exercises.prompt: You ___ come. We canceled the meeting.
exercises.explain: Đã đến mà thừa → needn't have come.

exercises.prompt: The hotel had towels, so we ___ bring any.

exercises.explain: Không được phép → aren't supposed to.

exercises.prompt: Câu nào nghĩa là ĐÃ mua?
options: I didn't need to buy bread.
exercises.explain: Needn't have bought: đã mua, hóa ra thừa.

exercises.prompt: The bus ___ to come at eight. Where is it?
exercises.explain: Lẽ ra phải → was supposed to.

exercises.prompt: You ___ so much food. Only four people came.
answers: needn't have cooked
need not have cooked

answers: didn't need

exercises.explain: Theo quy định → are supposed to.

exercises.prompt: I ___ to call her, but I forgot.
answers: was supposed
exercises.explain: Lẽ ra phải → was supposed to.
